title: Association between displacement and thickness of macula after vitrectomy in eyes with epiretinal membrane

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License)

condition: Unilateral idiopathic epiretinal membrane, 25-G pars plana vitrectomy with ERM and ILM peeling (Nagoya University Hospital), retrospective study of 20 eyes of 20 patients with OCT before and 2, 4 and 8 weeks after surgery; 19 of 20 eyes had combined phacoemulsification with IOL implantation

groups.agent: 25-G three-port pars plana vitrectomy with ERM and ILM peeling (19 eyes combined with phacoemulsification and IOL)
groups.description: All 20 analysed eyes (one eye per patient)

series.baseline_label: Week 0 = preoperative (Table 3 CFT row, column 2; the Results give the preoperative CFT that this cell holds)
series.notes: CFT defined as ILM to outer border of the RPE at the central fovea, caliper measurement on Spectralis OCT (central point); mean ± SD (Table 3 footnote); weeks after surgery converted as weeks x 7/30.4375 months; per-visit n not reported

exclusions.what: Table 3 INL and ORL quadrant rows
exclusions.reason: layer thicknesses at parafoveal quadrant points are out of scope (not central retinal thickness)

exclusions.what: Table 2 bifurcation-fovea distances and FAZ area

notes: Time origin: surgery; Week 0 is the preoperative examination
Treatment coded 'vitrectomy'; the combined cataract surgery in 19 eyes is recorded here and in the group agent
Prior treatment for the membrane is not stated
